title: Philadelphia Bayt – House Philadelphia
heading: One house. A place for community.
intro:
At the Mission House Philadelphia Two floors are open to refugees who, following the acceptance or rejection of their applications in the Greek asylum process, often suddenly find themselves without accommodation or adequate provisions. Many of them are then left to fend for themselves and end up on the streets.

With Beit Philadelphia – The Home Philadelphia We want to provide them with a safe place to live for one to two months whilst they look for work and organise the next steps in their lives. We support them with dealing with the authorities and paperwork, with finding work and, later on, with finding their own flat. During this time, they become part of our spiritual family. We are already seeing how people are finding new hope and taking steps towards an independent life.

Our aim is not merely to provide practical help. We pray that within the home Philadelphia Spiritual fruit also grows, and people come to know Jesus Christ and are strengthened in their faith.

Support for Beit Philadelphia

The monthly cost of the building and the work involved is just under 5.000 Euros. This includes the net rent of 2.700 Euros, approximately 1.300 Euros for electricity and water, as well as other costs for food, practical help and necessary administrative procedures.

That is why we are looking for 100 Brothers and sisters who support Beit Philadelphia with a monthly 50 Support with 50 euros. We see this support as a form of sponsorship and as a way of helping to sustain the project. Our supporters should be able to share in the life and development of the home and receive regular updates on how the project is progressing and the steps the residents are taking.

Together, we can offer people a home, practical support and a spiritual community during a particularly difficult transitional period!
